resources.string: Companion for the DevDeck menu bar app
Shows whether a coding agent or you are using this device right now.
Leave it alone while the agent works.
DevDeck marks this device as yours.
When a coding agent or you take it, DevDeck shows a marker here.
DevDeck updates this when an agent or you take this device.
The marker is turned off on this device.
You dismissed the marker; it comes back when the holder changes.
Notifications are blocked, so the marker can\'t be shown.
A silent notification with a status bar icon: a chip when an agent drives this device, a person when you hold it.

DevDeck is a macOS menu bar app for the simulators, emulators and dev servers that coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex use. It tracks which agent is driving which device, and installed this companion so the device itself shows it. There is nothing to set up here: DevDeck sends the state over adb.
